Userbase

Rules

Content and Behavior

Do not:

  • Post private content
    • This includes private messages, user info, or images.
    • Posting private surgery results is strictly prohibited and will result in a permanent ban.
  • Dox or threaten to dox
    • This applies to anyone, even those outside the community.
  • Mass-tag users
  • Spam
    • Includes AI-generated content or repetitive posting.
  • Use bots, scripts, or automation to post or manipulate reputation.
  • Impersonate users
    • Includes using someone else’s current or old username.
  • Spread misinformation
  • Advertise without staff permission.
  • Post LGBTQ+ content
  • Post low-effort content
    • Only allowed in the Offtopic section.
    • Not allowed in threads tagged as “Serious.”
  • Necropost
    • Avoid replying to threads older than 1 month unless you have a good reason.
    • “Bumps,” one-liners, quoting, or simple agreement are not valid reasons.
  • Post illegal content or incite illegal activity.
    • If you're unsure whether something is allowed, don’t post it.
  • Sexualize minors
    • Any individual under the age of 18.
  • Create more than one account or share your account
    • All accounts will be banned.
  • Post on behalf of banned users
  • Post gore and shock material
  • Repfarm
  • NSFW (nudity) profile pictures and banners
  • Pretending or mentioning to be a female to cause confusion on the forum and staff
    • Do not manipulate the reputation system for gain.
  • Exist solely to troll or intentionally disrupt the forum
    • While exaggerated personas may be tolerated, accounts whose primary or only intent is to antagonize others, incite conflict, or undermine the forum’s integrity will face permanent removal.


Other Guidelines

  • Ratings
    • Only belong in the Ratings subforum.
    • You cannot delete rating threads or attached images unless you're a VIP Supporter.
    • Learn more about VIP permissions.
  • [NSFW] and spoiler tags
    • Use when posting NSFW content under threads and posts.
    • Do not post NSFW content outside of appropriate threads or without a warning/spoiler tag.

FAQ


I have a serious inquiry or want to advertise

  • Use the “Contact” feature at the bottom of the page to reach the admin team.


How do I keep up with forum news?

  • Check the News & Announcements subforum regularly.
  • Follow us on:
    • Twitter
    • Instagram
    • Discord


How can I get VIP?

  • Read the official thread: VIP Support Info
  • Purchase VIP here: Upgrade Account


What is reputation?

  • Reputation appears under your username.
  • Each like or positive reaction (except “Anger”) gives you +1 reputation.
  • The more helpful your posts, the higher your rep.


What are trophies?

  • Trophies are badges you earn by completing milestones on the forum.
  • They don’t provide perks but are visible for flair.


How do I change the site theme?

  • Click the theme button in the bottom-left corner of the site.


When can I send PMs or vote in polls?

  • These features unlock automatically once you become active.
  • This is a spam-prevention measure — please be patient.


How do ranks work?

  • Every 500 posts unlocks a new rank.
  • Each rank also requires an additional week of registration time.
  • Spamming to skip ranks won’t work — the system auto-checks for abuse.
  • VIP users receive a special color and other perks. Learn more


How do I change my tag, privacy settings, or alerts?

  • Go to your Preferences page from your user profile.


Can I ignore a user?

  • Yes. Click their username and then click “Ignore.”


Can I edit or delete my posts and threads?

  • You have a 4-hour window to edit/delete posts.
  • You have a 4-hour window to edit threads — but cannot delete them.
  • VIP users can delete rating threads and their images.
  • You may request post removal from mods, but mass deletion is not allowed.


Can I change my username?

  • Yes, if you upgrade your account. Learn how
  • Creating a new account for a new name is not allowed.


Can I delete my account?

  • Yes. Visit: Account Deletion Thread
  • For temporary breaks (like to study), you can request a voluntary ban.


I deleted my account. Can I make a new one?

  • Yes, but not immediately. See: Policy on Deleted Accounts


Can I delete private messages?

  • Yes — but only if all participants in the conversation leave.
  • Use the “Leave” button in the conversation options.
  • Moderators cannot delete PMs for you.


How do I get alerts from a thread?

  • Click the “Watch” button at the top right of a thread.
  • You can also auto-watch threads after posting via your Preferences.


How do warnings work?

  • Warnings stay on your profile for 1 month by default (can be longer at mod discretion).
  • Each active warning adds to your total:
    • 60% = 1-day temporary ban
    • +10% = +1 day added
    • 100% = permanent ban
  • You can calculate your total from the %s shown in warning PMs.


How can I stay safe online?

  • Don’t post personal info (real name, phone, email, pictures, etc).
  • Use a VPN for added privacy.
  • Never post illegal content.
  • Avoid linking your real identity to your forum activity.


Why was X user warned or banned?

  • Warnings and bans are private.
  • Staff will not publicly share the reason.
  • You may privately message the user in question and ask them yourself.
